_README: Corpus Phase 3 (HIGH-10 / assessment 07 row 12): real external repos pinned at fixed SHAs. Sources are fetched into .cache/ (gitignored) by fetch.py; ground truth is human-labeled from the source AT THE PINNED SHA and committed under ground_truth/. Tests skip when a repo isn't fetched, so CI without network stays green; run `python tests/corpus/external/fetch.py` to enable them.
